releases.notes:
# Changelog

## [0.1.5] — 2026-09-14

### Added

- Automatic offhand placement and tool-selected breaking loop.
- Configurable start/stop, emergency-stop, and audit key bindings in a dedicated RapidCycle category.
- Optional AirPlace mode controlled by `/rapidcycle airplace on|off|toggle`; disabled by default.
- Mining-time audit based on Minecraft's live destruction-progress calculation.

### Fixed

- Restricted placement to offhand blocks.
- Prevented stale crosshair data from causing accidental AirPlace while the feature is disabled.
- Kept the implementation client-side so unmodified servers can accept normal vanilla interactions.
